race.comment: DAGGERS (12) will be looking to pick straight back up from where he left off last prep when in career-best touch. Has trialled sharply in readiness and is drawn to get all the favours for Thompson down in the weights. Hard not to see him playing a major role. LISZTOMANIA (7) is going as good as ever and has been able to settle much closer to the action this prep. If the pace is strong he has the turn of foot to round them up late. BIANCELLI (16) is ticking along nicely and while she's drawn wide with a clever steer she can give this a big shake under the featherweight. KRONENBOURG (1) has gone up a big price and while this does look a touch short of his best, he's got enough early speed to hold a good spot from his draw and give a great sight. There's ratings there. SER JOH (13) unleashed late to score here last month. Has been kept fresh with a month between, and suspect he will be doing his best work late again.
